rule.summary: This release predates the action's Node.js 24 runtime. GitHub no longer provides Node.js 20 on Actions runners. Version 6.0.0 and 6.1.0 still declare node20; version 6.2.0 and later declare node24.
rule.title: Unsupported actions/setup-go runtime
